application_rules: Capture actual Scout HEAD, index, owned paths, file hashes, local bindings and writer ownership before any local edits.

Matching source hashes need no write. Missing files may be added after ownership review. Divergent paths require explicit three-way/content review against actual Scout bytes and this reference; preserve newer Scout improvements.
Install original Git blob bytes with reviewed expected-before hash checks; do not copy the whole tree or normalize away line-ending differences.
If a justified Scout merge changes shared bytes, record new hashes and a new completion identity with focused checks; keep prior source identities.
Do not replace active workers or alter loaded source while a writer owns affected files; stage the verified candidate and report the exact installation fence.
Do not delete local files merely because absent from this manifest. This is a required source closure, not a complete checkout inventory.
Keep Scout shadow-only; installing Start-15m-Trader.cmd is not permission to invoke it.

mixed_fields.common: Model adapters, dependency specifications, code strategy defaults and portable launcher logic are shared.
mixed_fields.local: Retain actual Scout eleven-symbol membership and its profile/account identity, DATASTORE/watchlist paths, secrets and enabled/schedule settings. Review any mixed config by JSON field or source setting; do not exclude all common defaults.
mixed_fields.launcher: Check-15m-Readiness.cmd has a DATASTORE default; use Scout-local explicit diagnostic arguments or reviewed local override. Never copy an Atlas profile or impersonate Atlas.
mixed_fields.coordination: Launcher/exchange helpers use local bindings and the already verified installed cross_pc release. This manifest does not replace that release or copy its private bindings. Atlas-coordinator manual-start guards remain intact.

excluded_sibling.status: Separate pending-BUY valuation change; not part of this tree, not installed by this handoff. Preserve owner and review separately against #78.

check_limitations: Run with the verified installed network-disabled test_runner.py and fingerprints from this manifest. No model fitting, provider/broker calls, broad simulation or production databases. Atlas historical checks do not establish Scout installation or runtime success.
